results.name: Route interpolation is finite, normalized and anchored at authored portals
Insertion into a matching pair consumes the actual projectile and both existing balls
An inserted unmatched ball pushes forward neighbours and preserves order / spacing
Three equal colors separated by a real physical gap are not treated as a match
Removing a middle run preserves its gap; physical closure reconnects four outer colors as a second chain reaction
A nonmatching gap closes without an invented elimination
A aimed projectile travels through space, intersects a moving pair, inserts and produces a real win
Fire cooldown gates repeated shots; swap exchanges only the two queued colors
Shots leaving the field count as misses and do not delete a remote ball
Default learning run lasts 120–125 seconds when no shot is fired
Failure is triggered by the actual leading marble reaching the mouth; finished games do not advance
Saving in flight and during gap closure restores deterministic positions, projectile color and final rule outcome
Malformed colors, positions, duplicated IDs, overlaps, won/playing contradictions and projectile records fall back safely
Module starts inactive, pauses with exact rule state frozen and resumes only after explicit activation

limits: Renderer-independent rule and lifecycle checks. Art, real mouse/touch/keyboard interaction, default/narrow/fullscreen screenshots and browser errors require root CUA review.
